annotations.grafana.app/message: Manage SOMA Angie observability dashboard as code

spec.description: Terminal callback health, sessions, storage-gateway rollout, summary work, failures, and traces for SOMA's Angie workflows.
Completed Angie callback records in the selected range. This is the closest existing execution-outcome proxy, but it does not prove every downstream business side effect.
spec.title: Completed terminal callbacks

spec.description: Callbacks whose Angie session status was failed in the selected range.
spec.title: Failed terminal callbacks

spec.description: Terminal callbacks reporting rate_limited. This is session status, not HTTP 429 count.
spec.title: Rate-limited callbacks

spec.description: Master-workflow failures observed in the selected range.
spec.title: Master session failures

spec.description: Completed terminal callbacks divided by completed, failed and rate-limited callbacks. This is an execution proxy, not an end-to-end business SLI.
spec.title: Terminal callback completion ratio

spec.description: Failed plus rate-limited terminal callbacks as a share of observed terminal callbacks.
spec.title: Non-completed terminal callback ratio

options.content: **Callback status is the best existing terminal execution proxy, not a formal business SLI.** Callback processing can succeed even when a later orchestrator side effect logs an error. Storage attempts and transcript outcomes are deliberately separated on the Angie storage tab. Missing telemetry renders as **Unknown**, never healthy green.

spec.description: Callback HTTP acknowledgements by outcome and status class.
spec.title: Claude callback requests

spec.description: Callback-job processing outcomes. These are worker attempts, not Angie business results.
spec.title: Callback worker outcomes

spec.description: Callback and job processing span rate. Job retries are additional attempts.
spec.title: Angie workflow span rate

spec.description: P95 callback and job processing-span duration.
spec.title: Angie workflow p95 latency

spec.description: Terminal callback records in each rolling five-minute window.
spec.title: Terminal callback outcomes

spec.description: Master dispatch, completion-proxy and failure events.
spec.title: Master workflow activity

options.content: **`direct_v1` and `gateway_v2` identify instrumentation paths, not different metric families.** Compare the same runtime, provider, workflow, and operation. Every observed backend provider call or Angie logical action must appear under exactly one instrumentation path; do not compare absolute volume across runtimes. Backend rollout is `off` → `object_store` → `all`; enable Angie only after backend is stable. Roll back the relevant flag if forbidden/protocol failures appear, the gateway error ratio exceeds the larger of baseline +0.5 pp or 1.5× baseline, or P95 exceeds the larger of baseline +20% or +100 ms. Soak the first backend slice for 2 hours and 100 operations, then each full rollout for 24 hours.

spec.description: Failed gateway-v2 operations. Backend counts provider calls; Angie counts logical actions and does not expand curl's internal retries. This is not a unique-workflow failure count.
spec.title: Gateway failures / min

spec.description: Gateway-v2 forbidden and protocol failures. Any nonzero value blocks the rollout.
spec.title: Blocked classes / min

spec.description: Gateway-v2 retry events across both runtimes. Compare with failures to detect retry amplification.
spec.title: Gateway retries / min

spec.description: Storage observations the fail-open Angie datagram producer could not deliver. Missing telemetry is a rollout blocker, not a healthy zero.
spec.title: Angie observer drops / min

spec.description: Share of recently observed backend provider calls emitted through gateway-v2. This is rollout progress, not a health score, so it is deliberately uncoloured.
spec.title: Backend gateway-v2 traffic share

spec.description: Share of recently observed Angie logical actions emitted through gateway-v2. This is rollout progress, not a health score, so it is deliberately uncoloured.
spec.title: Angie gateway-v2 traffic share

spec.expr: sum by (runtime, provider, instrumentation, workflow, operation, outcome) ((label_replace((rate(soma_storage_operations_total[$__rate_interval])), "runtime", "backend", "runtime", "^$")) or (label_replace((rate(angie_storage_operations_total[$__rate_interval])), "runtime", "angie", "runtime", "^$")))

spec.description: Backend series count provider calls; Angie series count logical actions. Each observed operation must appear under exactly one instrumentation path. Native-shell curl retries remain inside one Angie action.
spec.title: Storage operations by runtime and instrumentation

spec.expr: 100 * ((sum by (runtime, provider, instrumentation) ((label_replace((rate(soma_storage_operations_total{outcome="error"}[$__rate_interval])), "runtime", "backend", "runtime", "^$")) or (label_replace((rate(angie_storage_operations_total{outcome="error"}[$__rate_interval])), "runtime", "angie", "runtime", "^$")))) or (sum by (runtime, provider, instrumentation) ((label_replace((rate(soma_storage_operations_total[$__rate_interval])), "runtime", "backend", "runtime", "^$")) or (label_replace((rate(angie_storage_operations_total[$__rate_interval])), "runtime", "angie", "runtime", "^$"))) * 0)) / clamp_min(sum by (runtime, provider, instrumentation) ((label_replace((rate(soma_storage_operations_total[$__rate_interval])), "runtime", "backend", "runtime", "^$")) or (label_replace((rate(angie_storage_operations_total[$__rate_interval])), "runtime", "angie", "runtime", "^$"))), 1e-9)

spec.description: Within-runtime operation error ratio: backend provider calls and Angie logical actions. Compare gateway with direct for the same runtime, provider, workflow, and operation; do not compare the two runtimes as if they have identical counting semantics.
spec.title: Attempt error ratio: direct-v1 vs gateway-v2

spec.expr: (label_replace((histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, provider, instrumentation) (rate(soma_storage_duration_milliseconds_bucket[$__rate_interval])))), "runtime", "backend", "runtime", "^$")) or (label_replace((1000 * histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, provider, instrumentation) (rate(angie_storage_operation_duration_seconds_bucket[$__rate_interval])))), "runtime", "angie", "runtime", "^$"))

spec.description: Backend provider-call and Angie logical-action P95 normalized to milliseconds. Fast failures can improve this value, so review it beside the error ratio.
spec.title: P95 latency: direct-v1 vs gateway-v2

spec.expr: sum by (runtime, provider, instrumentation, error_class) ((label_replace((rate(soma_storage_operations_total{outcome="error"}[$__rate_interval])), "runtime", "backend", "runtime", "^$")) or (label_replace((rate(angie_storage_operations_total{outcome="error"}[$__rate_interval])), "runtime", "angie", "runtime", "^$")))

spec.description: Failed operations grouped only by bounded error class. Forbidden and protocol are rollout blockers; use the logs below for safe request-level diagnostics.
spec.title: Storage failures by error class

spec.expr: sum by (runtime, provider, instrumentation, event) ((label_replace((rate(soma_storage_events_total[$__rate_interval])), "runtime", "backend", "runtime", "^$")) or (label_replace((rate(angie_storage_semantic_events_total[$__rate_interval])), "runtime", "angie", "runtime", "^$")))

spec.description: Explicit bounded semantic events from each storage boundary. Angie native-shell curl retries are not expanded into individual events. Compare explicit retry rate with failure rate to identify amplification.
spec.title: Retries, fallbacks and conflicts

spec.expr: sum by (runtime, provider, instrumentation, outcome) ((label_replace((rate(soma_storage_transfer_bytes_total[$__rate_interval])), "runtime", "backend", "runtime", "^$")) or (label_replace((rate(angie_storage_bytes_total[$__rate_interval])), "runtime", "angie", "runtime", "^$")))

spec.description: Application bytes supplied to storage calls per second. Error bytes were attempted, not confirmed stored.
spec.title: Attempted storage bytes

spec.description: Backend failures with provider, instrumentation, workflow, operation, error class, bounded upstream diagnostics, and trace context. No paths or payloads are recorded.
spec.title: Recent backend storage failures

spec.description: Angie failures with provider, instrumentation, workflow, operation, error class, and opaque correlation references. Expand a line for safe diagnostics.
spec.title: Recent Angie storage failures

spec.description: Session-level archive outcomes and terminal failures. Unlike provider metrics, one log event represents one recorder outcome.
spec.title: Terminal transcript archive outcomes

spec.description: Backend failure logs by safe upstream status and instrumentation path. Empty status means the failure did not include an HTTP response.
spec.title: Backend storage failures by upstream status

spec.description: Automatic summary status lookups in the selected range.
spec.title: Summary status lookups

spec.description: Automatic status lookup failures. A known zero is derived from the reporting metric.
spec.title: Failed status lookups

spec.description: Average database rows read per automatic lookup over 15 minutes.
spec.title: Rows read / lookup

spec.description: P95 automatic summary-status lookup latency.
spec.title: Lookup p95

spec.description: Automatic summary status lookup attempts by bounded strategy and outcome.
spec.title: Status lookup outcomes

spec.description: Database rows read by automatic summary lookups per second.
spec.title: Summary rows read rate

spec.description: P95 summary-status lookup latency split by strategy and outcome.
spec.title: Summary lookup p95 by outcome

options.content: These metrics describe the database lookup used during automatic summary extraction. They do **not** prove that the Angie session completed, that its transcript archived, or that a summary was ultimately delivered.

spec.description: Structured Angie warnings and errors across web and worker runtimes.
spec.title: Recent Angie warnings and errors

spec.description: Failed callback-worker spans. Open a row to inspect the full trace.
spec.title: Failed Angie workflow traces

spec.description: Failed callback/job processing spans. This is diagnostic and attempt-level.
spec.title: Angie workflow span errors

spec.description: Workflow and archival failures in rolling five-minute windows.
spec.title: High-value Angie failure events
